title: World Bloom — In an Ephemeral Embrace — Episode9 Together

meta.Event Outline: Several days before the meeting in the Asahina family household, the members of Nightcord at 25:00 notice something strange happening to the tree in their SEKAI. They each soon find themselves dreaming of very different lives.

rows.Line: A few days later
Gym

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Mafuyu Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Congratulations on placing third at the Kanto High Schools Invitational Archery Tournament. I hereby award you with this certificate to mark your great achievement.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: She placed third! She really is amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: She's top of the class too, and she even won an award the other day for that essay she wrote. She really can do it all!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow...
Miyamasuzaka
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for the wait. Especially after I invited you to walk home together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's okay. But what did that teacher need from you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, the school's apparently revising the pamphlet...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They wanted to know if it'd be okay for them to include a photo of me from today's ceremony in the gym.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really are an amazing person, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Between the archery club and school in general, you keep achieving all these incredible results.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All I know how to do is compose songs. So I'm just really impressed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Don't say that, Yoisaki.
Your songs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They're a source of warmth for so many people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Warmth, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I didn't realize that's how they sound to you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But my songs still leave a lot to be desired. I'm still nothing compared to my dad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sure that's not true...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know. Are there any things that you'd like to try other than composing songs?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Things I'd like to try?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Whatever is fine.
Anything that interests you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I am a little interested in the brass band.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The brass band?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, since playing music with others seems like fun. I feel like doing so would help broaden my horizons as a composer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Also, I'm not very good at writing essays...
Expanding my vocabulary and learning how to write better should help me produce better lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I'd like to learn how to draw.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Is that also to become a better composer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's right. I sometimes draw inspiration for songs from art. I feel like drawing things myself would let me see things from a different perspective.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, you should try doing all those things.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, all...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. It's like you said, who knows what might be of use to you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Still, all of them...?
I don't know if I can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Then, I'll help you.
We can try them together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give them all a try.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... In modern society, music serves as a source of happiness and relaxation for people...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Good. Your writing has improved quite a lot compared to where you were initially.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm starting to find it kind of fun thanks to you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Composing text is just like composing songs. I just need to write what I feel. And while I'm writing, the “melody” just seems to naturally come together as I go.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Lately, lyrics have been popping into my head before any music. I feel like I can go about composing in so many different ways now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
Hehe. In that case, I'll be looking forward to listening to your next song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think I've drawn this right. But what's wrong with it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
The background looks fine from my point of view, but it does feel a little cluttered, maybe.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I had a feeling.
I wanted to add some trees to the foreground, but I'm not sure there's any room now...
In that case, why don't you just draw what you want to the most?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What I want to the most...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. You're trying to draw everything, so you're losing focus and losing impact.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're Yoisaki, right?
Can you tell me what you're trying to capture?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I wanted to show the way the sun sparkles on the lake in between the big trees...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, you should focus more on how the light reflects off the water's surface. Like this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow, that's incredible...
It looks so much better already. But all you did was draw a couple lines.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is pretty basic stuff, you know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Thank you, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Ena looks like she's having fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I agree. Momoi, thank you again for introducing Shinonome to us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No problem. Ena has a habit of staying cooped up in her room if she's not given opportunities to meet people like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I think she needs breaks like this too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...
Music Room

rows.Speaker: Brass Band President
rows.Line:
Alright, we'll start playing in thirty minutes!
We've got a few students here to observe, so we'll be taking it easy today.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem a little anxious, Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...yes. I'm mostly excited. I am worried about whether I'll be able to do it right, though.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is also my first time, so let's do our best together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, let's both do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If you hadn't brought me here, Asahina, then I probably never would've actually done this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, let's have as much fun as we can today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
